WITH qualified_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l1.ID
  FROM Laboratory l1
  WHERE l1.`U-PRO` = '-'
  AND l1.ID IN (
    SELECT l2.ID
    FROM Laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.RA = '-'
  )
),
patient_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    AVG(l.PT) as pt_avg,
    AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) as tat_diff_avg
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM qualified_patients)
  GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT
  AVG(pt_avg) as overall_pt_avg,
  AVG(tat_diff_avg) as overall_tat_diff_avg
FROM patient_averages

alternatives.interpretation: The phrase "the average of TAT minus TAT2" interpreted as (average of per-patient TAT averages) minus (average of per-patient TAT2 averages), rather than the average of per-patient (TAT - TAT2) differences.
